one_receptor_same_assay: Yes: alpha-1 syntrophin PDZ; paper says N-terminal thioredoxin and His6 tags; exact boundaries not recovered
peptide_length_and_construct: 3 WT backgrounds, each 10 aa: CLDTSRETDL; SPDRDRESIV; NLKAGRETTV; 5 single substitutions per WT (15 total)
terminal_chemistry: All assay peptides N-terminally labeled with 5(6)-carboxytetramethylrhodamine. Exact C-terminal acid/amide status is not stated in the accessible synthesis methods; PDZ recognition requires a peptide C terminus, but that does not establish the precise terminal chemistry
assay_and_affinity: Fluorescence polarization, 20 nM labeled peptide, 25 C; Kd reported in Supplementary Table 7; figure caption says ΔΔG values are means of three experimental replicates
evidence_for_gain_and_loss: Paper reports one nonbinding variant and a model correlation across other 14 variants; exact per-variant Kd/error and gain/loss labels not verified because the PMC-hosted NIHMS90286 supplementary files return cache miss in available retrieval
PDB_and_match: 2PDZ is mouse alpha-1 syntrophin PDZ NMR complex with GVKESLV heptapeptide, not these three full 10-mers; receptor-family support but not exact assay ligand structure
development_or_exposure: Published predictor mutation-effect evaluation; parent ligands were among the highest-affinity peptides in that paper's model training data. Method-selection/development only; never call blind
project_and_training_overlap: Workspace search of output/pipeline/docs found no exact 2PDZ or syntrophin/iNOS candidate hit before this audit. WSL GraphPep training-list read was denied; no model-training exclusion claim
missing_information: Original Supplementary Table 7 and figure-level uncertainty; exact receptor boundaries; per-row Kd and error meaning/repeats; exact peptide C-terminal chemistry; fluorophore relation to the modeled interface; exact GraphPep training overlap
decision: CONDITIONAL_METHOD_SELECTION_ONLY; HOLD until supplement and input chemistry audit pass; not independent blind validation

primary_source: Kuang et al 2010 J Cell Biol; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2911665/
one_receptor_same_assay: Yes for the Kd panel: murine SPSB2 SPRY residues 12-224, GST removed before ITC; same receptor and assay
peptide_length_and_construct: Mouse iNOS residues 19-31, 13 aa; Table I has WT, single mutants and multi-mutants
terminal_chemistry: All synthetic peptide variants N-acetylated and C-amidated
assay_and_affinity: ITC at 25 C in 100 mM Tris-HCl, 150 mM NaCl, pH 8.0; Kd in nM with errors derived from Origin association-constant fit
evidence_for_gain_and_loss: Single mutants show weaker or near-WT binding in Table I; no documented ≥2-fold affinity-enhancing single mutant in the audited panel. Multi-mutants not eligible. Some variants are ND and censored.
PDB_and_match: 6KEY is a 1.24 A human SPSB2-human iNOS 9-residue complex released 2020; 3EK9 is apo murine SPSB2. Neither is an exact 12-224 murine receptor plus full 13-mer assay construct. 3EMW is SPSB2-VASA, different ligand.
development_or_exposure: Not found in prior local project reports/input audits; 6KEY is a later structure source and should be disclosed. Candidate considered in this source audit before any new scoring.
project_and_training_overlap: Workspace search of output/pipeline/docs found no exact SPSB2/6KEY hit. WSL GraphPep training-list read was denied; no model-training exclusion claim
missing_information: No measured gain direction; whether fit errors represent technical fit uncertainty or replicate variation; exact 6KEY chain-to-assay construct alignment and missing flanks; exact GraphPep training overlap
decision: EXCLUDE_AS_BIDIRECTIONAL_DIRECTION_PANEL; retain as loss-only mechanistic stress test, no pilot

primary_source: Li et al 2021 Acta Pharm Sin B; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8463443/
one_receptor_same_assay: Yes for MDM2 arm: same synthetic human MDM2(25-109) and SPR competition; do not mix separate MDMX receptor arm
peptide_length_and_construct: 12-aa PMI-L10A parent TSFAEYWNLASP plus 22 one-substitution analogs measured in Table 2
terminal_chemistry: Peptides made by Boc solid-phase synthesis and HF cleavage; unlabeled competitors in SPR. Exact peptide N/C terminal groups and resin/capping details are not stated. TAMRA is used on the separate PMI tracer in FP, not established for SPR analytes
assay_and_affinity: SPR competition, 25 C; 10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4; three independent experiments each in duplicate. Table 2 reports Kd and ± values, but the meaning of ± is not defined; do not infer SD/SEM
evidence_for_gain_and_loss: 22 of 94 analogs were first selected as stronger than PMI-L10A by FP and then have Kd reported. This is gain-enriched, not bidirectional. MDM2 Kd gains include T1L 123±10, A4L 98±5, N8A 229±11 nM vs parent 897±33 nM; error semantics remain unresolved. Non-selected analogs cannot be called measured losses.
PDB_and_match: 5UMM is MDM2-PMI-M3, not PMI-L10A or Table 2 variants; 3EQS is MDM2-parent PMI and 3LNZ is MDM2-PMI-N8A, related but not exact L10A-background complexes.
development_or_exposure: Same receptor/family as current PMI development and already considered in prior project data audit; disclose as within-family DEVELOPMENT/STRESS TEST, never independent family holdout. Paper's candidate selection is explicitly enriched for FP-improved sequences.
project_and_training_overlap: Exact 2021 analog sequences were not scored in prior workspace result tables; same-family GraphPep method-selection exposure exists. WSL GraphPep training-list overlap read denied; no exclusion claim.
missing_information: Exact peptide termini; meaning of reported ± and replicate aggregation; a measured same-assay set of non-enhancing single mutants; exact complex for L10A background; GraphPep training overlap
decision: PMI_SUPPLEMENT_ONLY; may be used for disclosed gain-side workflow sensitivity after input/error audit, but fails bidirectional and independent-family entry gates; no pilot now
